hypothesis: Removing beat-derived wording from Perplexity queries will recover the losses seen in the original grounded treatment.

enforcementAudit.explanation: The dispatch model received the original post as its search goal and no beat or profile, but the provider-executed tool's arguments are still model-generated and cannot be intercepted before execution.

conclusion: Query bias contributed to some regressions but was not the dominant cause. Source-only queries were less informative, triggered more searches, and degraded filtration further. A prompt-only prohibition cannot guarantee literal provider arguments.
